defects: The oversized flat hat brim dominates the head and hides the face and goggles in close views.
The shoulder plates are disproportionately broad and read as square pads.
The candidate's static torso harness duplicates the independently attached live role pack and adds visual bulk.
The cap's front gear is the only clear mechanical detail, leaving the side silhouette plain.
incumbent_comparison: First technically valid and visually inspected citizen candidate; retained as the best-so-far challenger while its specific silhouette and duplicate-equipment defects are addressed.
likely_causes: The procedural generator sets a 0.105-inch brim radius around a 0.066-inch head and does not constrain the brim against the face silhouette.
The v1 shoulder plates are 0.055 x 0.04 x 0.069 inches and are simple boxes with little taper.
The v1 generator still emits a static harness even though production-owned role equipment adds the live backpack and straps.
The v1 recipe concentrates cap detailing on the front gear and omits any side winding or finish ridge.
next_action_hypothesis: Generate citizen-v002 with a narrower brim and cap, reduce the shoulder plates to the planned 0.043 x 0.03 x 0.052 inches, omit the candidate-owned harness so production role equipment remains the only pack/strap system, and add a restrained side cap winding plus finish ridge. Keep the five animation pivots, half-inch dimensions, live role props, materials, and production camera conditions unchanged.

observations.art_direction_fit: The cap, twin brass-framed goggles, tailored coat, and metal details fit the miniature clockwork-worker direction in the production views. The broad cap and bulky plates make the finish more toy-like than tailored.
observations.close_up_quality: The run-009 detail capture shows the hat brim occluding much of the face; the shoulder pads and duplicated torso harness appear chunky beside the small buttons and goggles. This is a clear close-scale defect.
observations.gameplay_readability: At the captured settlement scale, the green coat, blue cap, and dark boots keep the citizen distinguishable among the 50-agent scene. The capture verifies candidate rendering but is not a task/navigation behavior test.
observations.geometric_detail: The close production captures show seams, lapels, buttons, goggles, cuffs, and boots, but many surfaces still resolve as repeated boxes and cylinders. The cap has little mechanical detailing beyond its front gear.
observations.material_realism: Fabric, leather, brass, glass, and iron use visibly different colors and responses in the close capture, but the fabric remains smooth and uniform and the hardware reads as clean simple shapes.
observations.proportion: The captured figure fits the half-inch envelope, but the brim and cap are wide relative to the head and shoulder plates are heavy for the narrow torso. The rendered goggles and short coat remain legible.
observations.scale_fidelity: Godot technical validation measures 0.264 x 0.5005 x 0.21 inches against the brief's 0.26 x 0.5 x 0.21 inches, and production rendering keeps the citizen at the expected miniature scale.
observations.semantic_recognizability: In the production three-quarter and detail captures, the figure reads as a clockwork worker through its cap, paired goggles, coat, gloves, and boots. The oversized brim partially hides the face and weakens the read.
observations.silhouette_quality: The production three-quarter and profile views show a broad flat brim and square shoulder plates that dominate the small head-and-shoulder silhouette. The live role pack also creates a bulky rear outline beside the candidate's static harness.
observations.surface_variation: The coat has mild procedural fabric variation, while the visible garment, hat, and leather surfaces remain largely uniform at the recorded close camera distance.
observations.technical_integration: The run-009 receipt confirms the registered production render loaded citizen-v001 through RoomScale's normal asset path with production_path=true; the 50-citizen presentation gate reports 50 registered assets and animated pivots. Godot import/bounds validation passed with no issues.
